About.title: People First. Possibilities Without Limits.
About.p1: INFIDELL TECHNOLOGY LLP is built on a simple conviction: meaningful recruitment begins with genuine human understanding. We do not treat talent as transactional data points, nor do we reduce company culture to arbitrary checklist items.
About.p2: For candidates, our specialists evaluate your aspirations, refine your credentials, and guide you directly toward career-defining milestones. For employers, we deliver curated, verified professionals who enrich your teams from day one.
About.philosophy: We measure our success not simply by placements made, but by the enduring longevity of the careers we shape and the institutional trust we cultivate with corporate partners.
About.candidateGuidance: Personalized career counseling, resume elevation, and continuous interview coaching.
About.employerSupport: Targeted candidate sourcing, rigor-backed profile screening, and reliable hiring lifecycles.
About.relationshipsMatter: Recruitment is an ongoing collaboration, not a one-time transaction.

Approach.principle1Desc: We begin by listening deeply. Before recommending a single opportunity or candidate, we assess career ambitions, organizational dynamics, and technical depth.
Approach.principle2Desc: We curate placements that genuinely advance long-term career trajectories, ensuring cultural resonance and mutual growth rather than short-term fixes.
Approach.principle3Desc: From bespoke interview preparation and portfolio reviews to compensation benchmarking, our advisory supports you through every crucial milestone.
Approach.principle4Desc: Placement is never our endpoint. We stay engaged post-onboarding, providing ongoing career touchpoints and strategic talent retention advisory.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Get clear answers about our recruitment process, candidate services, and employer partnerships.
FAQ.q1: Does Infidell charge any registration or placement fees from candidates?
FAQ.a1: No. Infidell does NOT charge job seekers any fees for registration, resume evaluation, interview scheduling, or placement. Our recruitment fees are compensated directly by our corporate hiring partners.
FAQ.q2: Does registering with Infidell guarantee immediate job placement?
FAQ.a2: No recruitment agency can ethically guarantee job placement. Placement depends on client hiring mandates, market conditions, and candidate performance during client interviews. However, we maximize your visibility by actively presenting your profile to matching employers.
FAQ.q3: How does the profile matching process work?
FAQ.a3: Once you register and upload your resume, our recruitment specialists review your academic qualifications, technical abilities, years of experience, and location preferences against our active corporate requisitions.
FAQ.q4: How can employers submit their hiring requirements?
FAQ.a4: Employers can register via our 'For Employers' portal, submit job descriptions and qualification criteria. A dedicated account manager will connect within 24 hours to initiate candidate shortlisting.
FAQ.q5: How does the Refer & Earn program work?
FAQ.a5: Registered individuals can refer candidates or corporate hiring clients via our Refer & Earn page. When a referred candidate completes the client's probation verification period, referral rewards are distributed according to program terms.
FAQ.q6: What documents do I need to register?
FAQ.a6: You will need an updated PDF/Word resume, basic educational details, skill inventory, and verified phone and email for verification.
FAQ.q7: Can candidates from outside Gujarat apply?
FAQ.a7: Yes, Infidell assists candidates nationwide across India for on-site, hybrid, and remote positions.
